sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors: methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Specific xEV conversion factors are provided because electric-car and van fleet shares are increasing.
The methodology covers BEVs, PHEVs and related range-extended electric vehicles.
PHEVs and range-extended vehicles are grouped into a single category because model counts remain relatively limited.
Fuel-cell electric vehicles are not currently included because meaningful fleet numbers are not yet available.
Direct petrol or diesel use by PHEVs is a Scope 1 component; BEVs have zero direct fuel-use emissions in this component.
Electricity generation used by xEVs is reported as Scope 2.
Electricity transmission and distribution losses for xEV use are reported as Scope 3.
Upstream liquid-fuel and electricity emissions for xEVs are reported as Scope 3 WTT components.
For assets not directly owned or controlled, total xEV components can feed Scope 3 business-travel, freight or managed-asset reporting.
From 2021, UK vehicle regulatory-data responsibility moved from EEA to the UK Vehicle Certification Agency for new UK xEV data.
